note: Neutral labels. Third-party arms are resolved from a LOCAL, unshipped file (arms.local.json in the benchmark home) that maps each 'local:' key to a path or package on the benchmark machine. See README.md > Arms.

arms.label: Plain Claude Code
arms.description: Claude Code with no video skill or plugin; same model, effort, tools on PATH, time cap and budget.

arms.label: showtime
arms.description: A frozen copy of this repository's shipped files minus benchmarks/ (so the arm cannot read the rubrics), loaded with --plugin-dir; runtime home (~/.showtime) already set up by `showtime setup`.

arms.label: Skill H (HTML-to-video framework: skills + CLI)
arms.description: An open-source HTML-composition video framework: its core agent skills copied into the isolated config dir, its CLI installed into an isolated prefix on PATH.

arms.label: Skill V (conversational footage editor)
arms.description: An open-source transcript-driven footage-editing skill, as shipped. Its transcription needs a cloud speech API key; the benchmark gives no arm a cloud key, so its footage path is expected to fail and is recorded as such.

arms.label: Skill B (single-file minimal video skill)
arms.description: A minimal one-file video skill: the lower bound of 'a skill, but a small one'.
